properties.decision: When reflow2 finds where two designs touch without anyone declaring it, it counts only exact evidence: the same file (artifact location or checksum) in both designs, or a pin (external_dependency) in one that names the other design's graph_id or source repository. Interfaces with closely matching names and the same medium are offered as candidates for the person or agent to confirm, labelled `computed` and never read as a declared seam. An empty answer says what was checked (declared pairs, computed links, or neither), so it never reads as agreement.
properties.name: Two designs are shown as touching only on exact evidence; a similar name is offered as a candidate, never as a link
properties.rationale: hxm_program's hub feedback (2026-10-20, item 3): with 14 members nobody hand-declares every seam, so the seam bucket stays empty exactly where cross-project bugs are. A fuzzy name match at 80/100 was already measured wrong across same-owner sibling projects (fact:defect-whether-a-project-link-is-real-cannot-be-asked); exact evidence avoids that failure, and pair_designs already computes name-based pairs that compose_and_analyse never calls.
